players.product: CMP polishing pads (hard and soft pads), CMP slurries and post-CMP cleaning solutions; immersion ArF and KrF wafer photoresists (8 grades on volume orders, 300-ton Qianjiang line ramping)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): semiconductor display materials (upstream materials for flexible OLED panels) had H1 2026 product sales of RMB 236 million. Yellow polyimide (YPI), photosensitive polyimide (PSPI) and thin-film encapsulation ink (TFE-INK) sell at scale; the company is first supplier of YPI and PSPI to some mainstream domestic panel makers, and its PSPI and TFE ink are in volume supply to G8.6 AMOLED lines, including first-batch supply to one of the world's first G8.6 AMOLED lines in commercial production. PFAS-free PSPI and black pixel-definition-layer material are in customer validation; low-dielectric ink and PI alignment liquid are in development and validation.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 display materials sales RMB 2.36 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company has entered optical-communication materials, driven by AI compute demand pushing optical communication to higher speeds, transferring its photoresist, powder and polymer-synthesis platforms into fiber coatings, thermal gel and optical coupling adhesive. Several products are sampling with downstream customers and some are expected to win orders within the year; the product line was shown publicly for the first time at the 27th China International Optoelectronic Exposition this month.

Management (IR record): H1 2026 net operating cash flow was RMB 567 million, up 29.26% year over year and above net profit attributable of RMB 529 million, helped by volume growth across semiconductor materials, cost control, the deconsolidation of the printing-consumables terminal business and the newly acquired Haofei New Materials. As of June 30, 2026 the company held 809 granted and pending patents (611 granted).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 operating cash flow RMB 5.67 hundred million (+29.26%); 809 patents granted and pending, 611 granted
